name: DükkanKit
author: rawsly

sections.description:
Configure invoice identity fields, Türkiye city and district selectors, and KDV rates from WooCommerce settings.

  • Invoice type, TCKN, and tax identity checkout fields.
  • City and dependent district checkout selectors.
  • Management of standard Türkiye KDV rates.
  • Translation-ready interface using WordPress language packs when available.
  • Explicitly confirmed cleanup of DükkanKit settings and order metadata.

The initial release offering is Free and Pro. Pro includes checkout editing and
custom fields, custom validation, Bulk KDV, PDF proforma downloads, and manual
order export. Free and Pro include local Support / Diagnostics and data cleanup.
Accounting integrations and automatic invoice creation are not included.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate a supported WooCommerce version (10.9 or 11.0).
  2. Install the Free or Premium plugin ZIP supplied through Freemius and activate it.
  3. Open DükkanKit in the WordPress admin sidebar to configure the plugin.
  4. For Premium, complete license activation when prompted.
sections.faq:
Does the Free version require a license?

No. The Free version opens DükkanKit settings without requiring an account or license activation.

Which package do I need for Pro?

Install the Freemius-generated Premium ZIP and activate your Pro license.
The Premium package replaces Free and retains its features and saved settings.

What happens when my Pro license expires?

Pro operations require an active license or eligible trial, subject to the
feature’s trial policy. Saved settings remain, Free features continue working,
and Bulk KDV recovery/undo remains available with Premium installed.

Where are the settings?

Open DükkanKit in the WordPress admin sidebar.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Initial Free and Pro release with DükkanKit branding and English/Turkish merchant documentation.
  • Pro checkout editing and custom fields, custom validation, local PDF proforma downloads, and manual order export.

  • Local Support / Diagnostics for Free and Pro.

  • Dedicated DükkanKit sidebar menu, with feature submenus and Support / Diagnostics last.

  • Bulk KDV: instant product-name search, retained selections, and clearer result headings and checkbox alignment.

  • Fix Bulk KDV category loading, Turkish search limits, and cleanup concurrency.
  • Bulk KDV: find products by name, select checkboxes across searches and pages, and inspect current KDV classes before previewing.
  • Fix returning from Bulk KDV review to a new selection; keep recovery-history confirmation visible.

  • Fix the KDV apply unsaved-changes warning and clarify Bulk KDV selection, progress and recovery in English and Turkish.

  • Premium: Bulk KDV product/category preview, batched tax-class assignment, and guarded undo with recovery after paid license expiry.

  • Invoice identity fields, city and district selectors, KDV configuration, and DükkanKit data cleanup.
